fields.name: birthDate
fields.description: Original birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to determine natal Sun longitude for the solar return calculation.

fields.name: birthTime
fields.description: Original birth time in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format. Determines exact natal Sun position for annual return timing.

fields.name: returnYear
fields.description: Year for which to cast the solar return chart. The chart is erected for the exact moment the transiting Sun conjuncts the natal Sun longitude in this year.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the solar return location in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Use current residence or travel location at time of birthday. Solar return charts are location-sensitive.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the solar return location in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Affects house cusps and Ascendant of the return chart.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Decimal hours from UTC OR IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York"). IANA resolved to the DST-correct offset for the birthDate. Output datetime is adjusted to this timezone.

fields.name: houseSystem
fields.description: House system for the solar return chart. Placidus (default) is most common in Western astrology. Whole Sign, Equal, and Koch also supported.
